guard: cotal channel members shows a family follower (#5404) as a durable member of the durable-class channels under the family only, and a follow sees the class move
why: The suite's script builds cotal-ai and its dependencies before it runs, so each mutation rebuilds after the restore.
L1 never counts the family row, so fern is no durable member of #team.build.
L2 counts the family row whatever the class, so fern reads as a durable member of the live #team.chat.
L3 copies every heartbeat into the last census, so a follow never sees #team.build turn live.

mutations.name: L1 the family row never counts
mutations.expectRed: while connected, fern is a live and durable member of #team.build
mutations.cell: while connected, fern is a live and durable member of #team.build

mutations.name: L2 the family row counts on a live-class channel
mutations.expectRed: while connected, fern is a live member of #team.chat with no stored copies
mutations.cell: while connected, fern is a live member of #team.chat with no stored copies

mutations.name: L3 a heartbeat ignores a class change
mutations.expectRed: the follow drops fern once #team.build turns live, with no membership change
mutations.cell: the follow drops fern once #team.build turns live, with no membership change
